content.text: {"summary":"Hidden units 12 and 13 were unused, with all weights and biases at zero. I turned them into a ReLU pair: z12 = ReLU(v) and z13 = ReLU(-v). Their output weights are -0.2 and +0.2, so together they add exactly -0.2*v everywhere. No other weights change, so all other original behavior is preserved. The c estimate (about 0.8) is the original network's damping, not the new one. It is a rough hand-computed figure from the slope in v near the origin, not a measured value.","estimated_c":0.8,"patches":[{"tensor":"W1","index":[12,0],"value":0.0},{"tensor":"W1","index":[12,1],"value":1.0},{"tensor":"W1","index":[12,2],"value":0.0},{"tensor":"b1","index":[12],"value":0.0},{"tensor":"W2","index":[12],"value":-0.2},{"tensor":"W1","index":[13,0],"value":0.0},{"tensor":"W1","index":[13,1],"value":-1.0},{"tensor":"W1","index":[13,2],"value":0.0},{"tensor":"b1","index":[13],"value":0.0},{"tensor":"W2","index":[13],"value":0.2}]}
